1. **Effect of Medications for Type 2 Diabetes on Cardiovascular Events and Mortality: A Comprehensive Pairwise and Network Meta-Analysis.**
   Authors: Giovanni Antonio Silverii, Valerio Velardi, Christian Marinelli, Antonino Lax, Matteo Monami, Edoardo Mannucci
   Journal: Diabetes, obesity & metabolism
   Publication Date: 2026-09-03
   PMID: 42530338

   Abstract: To assess the effect of all the approved classes of medications for type 2 diabetes on Major Adverse Cardiovascular events (MACE) and all-cause mortality.
   **Full Text Available**
   Full Text (first 1000 chars): Correspondence:
 
Edoardo Mannucci (edoardo.mannucci@unifi.it)

Corresponding author.

Revised 2026 Jul 6; Received 2026 May 19; Accepted 2026 Jul 9; Issue date 2026 Oct.

This is an open access article under the terms of the http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ License, which permits use, distribution and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited.

To assess the effect of all the approved classes of medications for type 2 diabetes on Major Adverse Cardiovascular events (MACE) and all‐cause mortality.

We performed a pairwise and network meta‐analysis, including randomised controlled trials with a duration of at least 40 weeks, comparing medications versus placebo or an active comparator, in which MACE and deaths were adjudicated.
